content_units: Kyoto 3-Day Weather Snapshot
Kyoto looks progressively better each day from   wet   to   clear and warm  .
-   Oct 12:   Cool and damp with   light rain
-   Oct 13:   Mild and mostly pleasant with   partly cloudy skies
-   Oct 14:   Best overall weather with   sunny skies   and very low rain risk
